output.summary: A low, clump-forming perennial herb found wild predominantly in Europe and western Asia. Its yellow flowers almost always have four notched petals, an unusual number in the rose family. The bitter root has little food value but is used in regional liqueurs, while the dry fruits are inedible.
output.edibilityNote: The bitter, low-calorie root is used in Bavarian, Black Forest and Ukrainian alcoholic drinks; the dry fruits are inedible.
